title: Real-time supervisor alert never fires
scenario: A conversational analytics real-time rule should email floor supervisors while an upset caller is still on the line. Three escalations this week produced no alert, although the rule is published, its phrases match the working post-call rule and the change passed a sandbox test. You get flow logs, the inbound flow and a shared recording-defaults module, both rules, post-call excerpts, the EventBridge archive and Kinesis metrics.
task: Trace the effective analytics settings along the call path in the flow logs
Explain why the sandbox test passed and rule out the Kinesis red herring
Fix the flow/module so real-time analytics is in effect at the agent leg on every path
Keep the PCI redaction defaults and the published real-time rule
acceptance: RealTime effective at transfer on all four paths; redaction still RedactedOnly
Module still invoked before every transfer; blocks wire NoMatchingError and ChannelMismatch
Rule unchanged as a real-time rule
Root cause with evidence in ANSWER.md
